title: Row-data tool segment set
description: The tool-name segments that mark a tool as a row/cell/query-result fetcher, as data. The tokenizer travels with the set deliberately: a binding that reads the segments and infers the folding and splitting rules from its own language's defaults is the failure mode this artifact exists to prevent.

fold.description: How a tool name is case-folded before splitting. Spelled as an explicit code-point range rather than as 'lowercase', because lowercasing is the most locale- and Unicode-table-dependent operation this check could perform.

range.description: Inclusive source range. Every code point outside it is left unchanged.

to.description: Inclusive destination range, mapped one to one from `range`.

split.description: How the folded name divides into segments.

pattern.description: The normative separator expression, in a portable subset: no lookarounds, no backreferences, no Unicode property escapes, and no shorthand class whose meaning varies by language.

items.description: Spelled in the alphabet the split can actually produce. A segment containing anything else could never match.
